description: A FastAPI dependency example demonstrating use of query parameters, cookies, and dependency injection.

methods.name: query_extractor(q: str | None = None)
methods.description: Extracts a query parameter 'q' from the request, returning None if not present.

methods.name: query_or_cookie_extractor( q: str = Depends(query_extractor), last_query: str | None = Cookie(default=None) )
methods.description: Uses dependency injection to get 'q' from query parameters and 'last_query' from cookies, returning 'last_query' if 'q' is not provided.

methods.name: read_query(query_or_default: str = Depends(query_or_cookie_extractor))
methods.description: Endpoint handler that returns a JSON with the value of 'q_or_cookie' extracted via dependencies.

ctags.name: query_or_cookie_extractor
ctags.signature: ( q: str = Depends(query_extractor), last_query: str | None = Cookie(default=None) )
